name: agentmesh-action-provider
description: Coinbase AgentKit Action Provider for autonomous coding agents to execute AST patching and microVM runs with automated Base L2 USDC micro-payments.
author: s6pa1rta3n-lab

actions.name: apply_ast_patch
actions.description: Surgically replaces code using Tree-sitter AST nodes with zero syntax regressions. Automatically pays $0.0002 USDC on Base if required.

actions.name: build_call_graph
actions.description: Traces caller and callee hierarchy for a function/struct without reading raw files. Automatically pays $0.0001 USDC on Base if required.

actions.name: create_microvm_sandbox
actions.description: Forks a 3.4ms isolated Copy-on-Write microVM execution container. Automatically pays $0.0005 USDC on Base.
